title: Everyone Ai
one_liner: Self-service AI workspace platform for launching Claude Code environments via Kubernetes.
what_it_is: A portal that allows team members to launch pre-configured VS Code workspaces backed by Claude Code without local setup. It manages Kubernetes pods, ingress routes, and workspace templates through a Node.js API and static frontend.
how_its_built: Built with Node.js/Express for the backend API, vanilla JavaScript for the frontend SPA, and Helm charts for Kubernetes deployment. Uses k3s for lightweight cluster management and Traefik for ingress routing. Includes a CLI tool called afterburner for bootstrapping and management.
how_to_apply: Operators use the afterburner CLI to bootstrap k3s on Linux VMs and deploy the portal via Helm. End users connect via VPN, access the portal URL, select a template from the App Catalog, and launch a workspace to get a browser-based VS Code instance with Claude Code ready.
quickstart:
npx afterburner bootstrap --host <ip> --ssh-key ~/.ssh/id_rsa
npx afterburner install
helm install everyone-ai-portal ./charts/portal -f profiles/k3s.yaml -f config.yaml --namespace myteam --create-namespace
open https://portal.<your-domain>
features: App Catalog with pre-configured Claude Code templates
One-click launch of personal VS Code workspaces in browser
Automatic Kubernetes pod and ingress management
Team-wide usage monitoring and fleet overview
CLI tools for operator bootstrap and lifecycle management
